lines: ◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and the galaxy, which came to watch a monster, leaves afraid of the right things. The fear is a shield now, held over a village that trusts the hand that holds it.

◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — but the table keeps the contract he priced, because the galaxy still needs what he taught it. The village endures, and this time the table owes the village.

◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and the audience, which came to be entertained, leaves humming the village's name. The village endures, loved and unbeholden, and the lights stay warm behind he.

◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — with every charge read aloud and answered, the ledger closed and clean. The village endures, and the record stands: what was hidden is hidden no more.

◈ Darius Bauer does not walk out of the light — he went inside carrying the truth, and the light, unsteadily, has begun to carry it back. The village endures, with a Trojan horse in the walls of heaven.

◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and keeps walking, because he paid every price and said no twice. The village endures, poorer, unowned, free: the long shot of small figures leaving the light is the highest-rated thing the galaxy ever saw.

◈ Darius Bauer walks out of the light accompanied — the System learned he name first, and it keeps saying it inside the wire while he goes home. The village endures, with a friend in the machine, and the conversation does not end.
